description:
Get a token's current USD price on Base or Ethereum, read from its deepest Uniswap v3 pool (against USDC or WETH) rather than a price API. Returns the pool used, its fee tier, how much liquidity backs the price, and a flag when the pool is too thin to trust.

$0.003 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

name: token_price
title: Token price
